entities.name: Great Marsh
entities.description: A large area of bogs on Tamingazin in Otaria, setting of a decisive mission.

entities.name: Tamingazin
entities.description: Subcontinent and valley defended against the Suder invasion.

entities.name: En'Jaga
entities.description: Giant, monstrous soldiers of the marsh loyal to Suderbod.

entities.name: Attalo
entities.description: Fierce giant tortoises of the marsh.

entities.name: Betrayal of Tamingazin
entities.description: The betrayal during the Suder invasion of the Valley.

entities.name: Recin
entities.description: An exiled Garan elf who retrieved the Magewall Hub.

entities.name: Kitrin
entities.description: A young mage who killed Solin with her tracking crystal.

entities.name: Magewall Hub
entities.description: Artifact maintaining the Valley's magical defenses.

entities.name: Aligarius Timni
entities.description: A mage who stole the Hub, later guilt-ridden and helped escape.

entities.name: Ursal Daleel
entities.description: Suderbod ambassador and mastermind, devoured by an attalo.

entities.name: Hemarch Solin
entities.description: Cruel leader of Suderbod killed by Kitrin.

events.summary: Recin and Kitrin enter the marsh to retrieve the stolen Magewall Hub.
events.quote: Their goal was to retrieve the Magewall Hub

events.summary: Recin and Kitrin are captured by En'Jaga and imprisoned in Solin's camp.
events.quote: The marsh had now become a prison for the two.

events.summary: Kitrin kills Solin with her tracking crystal thrown as a dagger.
events.quote: Kitrin used her tracking crystal as a throwing dagger, killing Solin in the process.

events.summary: Aligarius helps them escape; they incapacitate Ursal and flee with the Hub.
events.quote: fled the camp with the Magewall Hub in hand

events.summary: Aligarius reactivates the Magewall while Recin fights the guard and an attalo devours Ursal.
events.quote: a hungry attalo , a monstrous swamp tortoise , devoured the ambassador whole

events.summary: Kitrin rescues Recin from drowning; the reappearing Magewall halts the Suder army and Tallibeth's defenders push them back.
